hard_limits.derivation: Conservative one-byte-per-prompt-token liability plus 1024 completion tokens at provider max prices: baseline 30.79088650 USD; treatment base 31.02598950 USD plus worst-case 332 swapped-order pair calls 53.27439150 USD. Provider attempts equal logical calls, so retries cannot expand the authorized attempt count.

scratch_database: No database is opened by the paid reader command. It consumes the two immutable evidence files above, generated by packaged MemPhant in the named run-owned scratch databases, both already dropped.
pass_predicates: both reports cover all 178 rows with zero reader, parse, or judge errors and no abort
every provider attempt is durably ledgered, priced, settled, and within all hard limits
paired bootstrap 95 percent CI lower bound for treatment minus baseline supported-answer accuracy is greater than zero
every correctness flip has two swapped-order pair adjudications with status resolved
the 12-case exact-abstention subset does not regress
kill_predicates: any input, evaluator, schema, model, provider, or question-set hash drift
any reader, parse, judge, pairing, position, pricing, settlement, or attempt-ledger error
any hard call, provider-attempt, price, output-token, or spend ceiling is exceeded or the next call would exceed it
paired accuracy CI lower bound is less than or equal to zero
abort_settlement: Stop issuing calls immediately. Preserve the partial report and append-only attempt ledger. Ambiguous transport attempts retain their maximum liability and make the run promotion-ineligible; no rerun or cache deletion occurs without a new audit.
